1.o: يكتشف الطالب في المدرسة الثانوية لايت ياغامي دفترًا غامضًا يسمح له بقتل أي شخص عن طريق كتابة اسم الشخص بينما يتصور وجهه.

2.o: يختبر لايت قوى دفتر الموت من خلال قتل مجرم. يحذر ريوك، شينيجامي الذي أسقط دفتر الموت، لايت من أن شخصًا ما يأتي لتعقب الكتاب.

3.o: يبدأ لايت في التجربة باستخدام دفتر الموت من خلال كتابة اسم مختطف على ورقة من دفتر الموت.

4.o: يشرح ريوك طبيعة دفتر الموت للايت، بما في ذلك مفهوم الشينيجامي. يستمر لايت في استخدام دفتر الموت للقضاء على المجرمين.

5.o: يستخدم إل الوفيات الغامضة لعدة عملاء من مكتب التحقيقات الفدرالي لاستنتاج أن كيرا في اليابان. يحاول لايت اكتشاف هوية إل الحقيقية.

6.o: يبدأ لايت وإل محادثة مباشرة من خلال سلسلة من البثوث التلفزيونية. يقدم إل نفسه للعالم ويبدأ التحقيق للقبض على كيرا.

7.o: يجند إل مساعدة العميل راي بينبر لتحديد الشخص الذي كان يتبعه. يقوم لايت بالتحرك للتخلص من راي.

8.o: ينضم لايت إلى فرقة العمل ويمرر دفتر الموت إلى مالك جديد محاولًا معرفة اسم إل الحقيقي. يظل إل مشككًا في لايت.

9.o: يستمر لايت بحثه عن اسم وهوية إل الحقيقية. يكلف إل لايت بمراقبة أعضاء مشتبه بهم في مجموعة يوتسوبا، شركة يشتبه في أنها تحتضن أنصار كيرا.

10.o: يلتقي إل والد لايت ويقدم نفسه لفرقة العمل. يقترب لايت وإل من بعضهما البعض بينما ينضم لايت إلى فرقة العمل ومتابعة التحقيق في مجموعة يوتسوبا مستمرة.

11.o: تعين مجموعة يوتسوبا إل لمساعدتها في التحقيق في كيرا. يقتنع إل بأن لايت هو كيرا، لكن والد لايت عازم على إثبات براءة ابنه.

12.o: يكشف إل عن خطته النهائية لفضح لايت ككيرا من خلال دعوة مجموعة يوتسوبا لاجتماع مع فرقة العمل. يدرك لايت

13.o: يكشف "إل" عن خطته الأخيرة لكشف "لايت" بدور "كيرا". مع اشتداد المواجهة بين "إل" و"لايت"، يجب على فريق العمل أن يقرر إلى أي جانب يقفون.

14.o: يُظهر لايت وميسا لبعضهما البعض مذكرات الموت الخاصة بهما، ويطلب لايت من ميسا أن تجعل الشينيغامي ريم الخاص بها يتخلص من L.

15.o: تظهر الأدلة التي تشير إلى أن ميسا أماني هي كيرا الثانية.

16.o: ميسا في الحبس، على الرغم من أن ذكرياتها عن مذكرة الموت قد تم محوها بالكامل.

17.o: بعد خمسين يومًا من الحبس، استمرت عمليات القتل، وتم إطلاق سراح ميسا ولايت.

18.o: على الرغم من أن L لا يزال متشككًا، إلا أن لايت وميسا، بعد أن تم مسح ذكرياتهما عن كونهما كيرا، يعودان إلى المقر الرئيسي...

19.o: ماتسودا، عضو فرقة العمل المكلف بمراقبة ميسا، حريص على تمييز نفسه...

20.o: يكتشف فريق L أن مجموعة يوتسوبا تجتمع سرًا لمناقشة التخلص من الأفراد الذين يسببون إزعاجًا لشركتهم...

21.o: تقوم مجموعة يوتسوبا بتعيين إيرالدو كويل  للكشف عن هوية L.

22.o: تنجح ميسا في تضييق نطاق المشتبه بهم في كيرا في مجموعة يوتسوبا إلى شخص واحد: هيجوتشي.

23.o: يحاول هيجوتشي من مجموعة يوتسوبا قتل ماتسودا من فريق العمل، ويتفاجأ عندما لا يموت بعد ٤٠ ثانية.

24.o: تم القبض على هيغوتشي وأخبر المحققين عن مذكرة الموت.

25.o: استعاد لايت ذاكرته، وأمر ميسا بالبدء في القتل بعد وفاة هيجوتشي.

26.o: لقد أزاح النور كل من في طريقه وأصبح أقرب إلى تحقيق عالمه المثالي.

27.o: يتقدم محقق جديد للأمام - نير، شخصية مركزية في SPK، وهي منظمة تحاول القبض على كيرا دون الاعتماد على L.

28.o: يكشف لايت، الذي يلعب دور L، لـ Near أن أخته Sayu قد اختطفت على يد شخص يريد مبادلتها بمذكرة الموت.

29.o: يحاول لايت اكتشاف المكان الذي يختبئ فيه ميلو ورفاقه في المافيا ويستخدم عيون ميسا للعثور على المالك الحالي لمذكرة الموت.

30.o: اقتحم ميلو مقر SPK لاستعادة صورة لنفسه للتأكد من أنه لن يقتل على يد كيرا.

31.o: يتصل بالقرب بفرقة العمل اليابانية ويقرر أن كيرا من بين أعضائها.

32.o: المذيعة النجمة كيومي تاكادا تصبح المتحدث الرسمي باسم كيرا للعالم...

34.o: يكتشف أيزاوا ما يحدث ويخبر نير، الذي يعرف بالفعل أمر الملاحظات.

35.o: يعطي الضوء لكيومي الأمر بالقضاء على القريب.

36.o: يلتقي Near، جنبًا إلى جنب مع SPK، مع Light وفرقة العمل في أحد المستودعات للمواجهة النهائية.

37.o: على الرغم من أن ميكامي قد كتب جميع أسماء المحققين في مذكرة الموت، إلا أن دقيقة تمر ولا يزال الجميع على قيد الحياة.

4.o: Dani wishes she had a boyfriend for her high-school reunion so Oscar, Felix and Ted work on finding her a man.

7.o: Felix convinces Oscar to appear on a sports television show against Teddy’s advice to stick with radio.

1.o: After Oscar and Felix become obsessed with eavesdropping on their bickering neighbors, they try to subtly intervene and help them save their marriage. Meanwhile, Emily and Dani's friendship is tested when they train together to race to the top of the Empire State Building.

2.o: With the help of Murph, Oscar decides to throw a big party when Felix finally agrees to spend the weekend away. Also, Felix and Emily have their first sleepover.

3.o: Oscar faces a personal dilemma when he dates a young nanny, Allyson, who works for his neighbor, Charlotte. Also, Emily forces Felix to participate in an activity she's interested in, for a change.

5.o: Oscar attempts to impress Charlotte by purchasing a table for a fundraiser to benefit The New York Philharmonic. At the event, Felix reminds Oscar about the importance of being honest and Teddy introduces his wife, Diane, to Dani for the first time.

6.o: Oscar and Charlotte hit a speed bump when they hesitate to take their relationship to the next level. Also, Felix attempts to overcome his fear of dogs with Teddy's help when Emily regains custody of Biscuit.

7.o: Oscar reluctantly agrees with his agent that it’s time to shake things up on his radio show and allows Dani to have a bigger role after a rival host, Rich Eisen, taunts him. Also, Felix is eager to meet Emily’s mother, Judy (Joanna Cassidy), but things don’t go as well as he hoped.

8.o: Felix attempts to reverse Emily's birthday curse and plans a nice dinner to celebrate with friends. Also, Oscar and Charlotte face another obstacle in their relationship when Oscar meets Charlotte's son, Evan (Caleb Brown).

9.o: Oscar learns that Felix was nationally ranked chess player as a child and convinces him to return to the game to make money. Also, Emily investigates why Felix is acting strange since he began playing chess again,

10.o: Felix forces Oscar and Emily to go on a date to get to know each other better in the hope that they’ll become friends. Also, Teddy agrees to help Dani with her first contract negotiation.

11.o: In an attempt to surprise Emily, Felix gets his learner’s permit and enlists his friends to help him learn how to drive. Also, Oscar is annoyed that Felix doesn’t ask him for help,

12.o: Oscar and Felix run a heated campaign for president of their building’s tenants’ association, but Oscar doesn’t fully realize everything the position entails.

13.o: After Murph persuades Oscar to try online dating, Oscar finds himself on a blind date with Felix’s ex-wife, Ashley.

In the morning of the school's welcome ceremony while on the train in a chance encounter she meets a girl from a different high school, named Akira Okudaira. As it just so happens, these two girls were childhood friends who had not seen each other for 10 years until now. This meeting at the station on the way to school, brought tears to Fumi's eyes. Akira saying that Fumi hasn't changed much since they were kids softly handed her a handkerchief to wipe away the tears...

Entering school and overcome with excitement, Akira and fellow classmate - Kyouko Ikumi - decide to join the drama club. When revealing her predicament to Akira, she laughs and they come up with a solution to her problem. In the meantime, Kyouko starts to inquire about Yasuko...

5.o: Preparations for the school production and upper classmen's musical number are in full swing. With Yasuko making a guest appearance as the protagonist, Heathcliff, many of her fans have gathered in great excitement to see her performance. However, there's only on person on her mind: Fumi. Kyouko approaches Yasuko and carefully acknowledges that she knows about her and Fumi, which brings about some uneasiness to Fumi. This causes her to ask Yasuko a question about her first love.

Finally the upper classmen begin their performance of "Wurthering Heights." Fumi heart skips a beat at the sight of Yasuko's performance on stage. At the end of the performance, Fumi is taken aback as her senpai starts to cry.

7.o: The day after Fujigaya's theatrical festival, Akira and Fumi head off to Yokohama for a day to play. On that day, Fumi decided to stay over at Akira's place, making Yasuko a bit uneasy as she expressed her thoughts to Akira. After hearing Akira's thoughts on the matter, Yasuko decided to let it go. However, she later decides to invite Fumi to her home...

8.o: Fujigaya's school newspaper announces that Mr. Kagami is getting married. He states that he had no prior knowledge of Yasuko's prior experience, after being cross examined by Kyouko. With all this going on, Yasuko has been giving Fumi the cold shoulder, and, unwilling to take any more of this, Akira confronts Yasuko on behalf of Fumi...

9.o: Summer vacation arrives, and Kyouko starts inviting people to a summer trip, even to Kou Sawanoi. It seems like everyone's invited except, Akira and Fumi. However, they are plenty busy with other plans for the summer holiday. However on Kyouko's camping trip during a "test of courage" activity, Kou debates whether or not to reveal a huge secret...

10.o: As the new semester begins, Kazusa Sugimoto and Mr. Kagami's wedding day is finally here. Akira, Kyouko and the theater members attend the ceremony. And while everyone is excited to meet the family, all Kyouko can do is look at Yasuko. While many emotions and thoughts fill the air, the bride and groom are greeted mostly with blessing for their wedding. After the ceremony, Fumi and Akira meet up at Enoshima to hang out, but to their surprise another unexpected guest appears.

11.o: In the blink of an eye, summer has past and fall has sunken in. Yasuko's basketball team has begun to excel pushing them into the national tournament. However, a rumor about Yasuko going to study in England after graduation begins to spread, which comes as a shock to Kyouko. In the meantime, Fumi runs into Yasuko at the train station, and looking at each other together.

1.o: “I am the Lord thy God; thou shalt have no other God but me.” Ten-year-old Pawel and his father Krzysztof run their lives on their beloved home computer, while Pawel’s aunt worries that his spiritual education is being neglected. But Pawel is too busy enjoying life, not least thanks to his father’s Christmas present of a pair of ice skates, because the computer has calculated that the frozen lake is safe to skate across…

2.o: “Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain.” An elderly doctor is approached by a woman with a complicated request. Her husband is gravely ill and may die, and she is pregnant by someone else. If her husband dies, she wants to keep the child, but not otherwise, and she wants the doctor to give him an honest verdict on his chances. But the doctor is disturbed by her request, because his answer will directly affect the life or death of another human being. Is he entitled to play God?

3.o: “Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.” Janusz is a taxi driver. It’s Christmas Eve, and he honours the (Polish) traditions for this (holy) day: he gives presents to the members of his family and attends Midnight Mass. Later, Ewa, a woman who he had betrayed his wife with three years earlier, asks him to help her. Her husband is missing, and she asks him to help her search for him. Should Janusz stay home to keep the day holy? Or should he help Ewa, who says she needs his help, to keep the day holy? Is it his duty to help her? This episode seems to be about both…

4.o: “Honour thy father and thy mother.” Young Anka and her father have lived together since her mother’s death, and have always been more like close friends than father and daughter. One day, Anka discovers a letter from her mother whose contents make her question her whole relationship with her father… if that’s indeed who he is.

5.o: “Thou shalt not kill.” A shorter, slightly less graphic version of “A Short Film About Killing,” but the plot is essentially the same: murder followed by execution, two killings, one illegal, one legal, both hideous.

6.o: “Thou shalt not commit adultery.” A shorter, scaled-down version of “A Short Film About Love,” with a less complex plot and a different ending—though the basic narrative about the relationship between a lonely 19-year-old boy and the thirty-something artist that he spies on every night is the same.

7.o: “Thou shalt not steal.” But in this case the “theft” is of a child by her real mother, who then finds herself emotionally unable to cope with the responsibility, while the stable and loving family that brought the child up are distraught.

8.o: “Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.” A Polish-American researcher visits Warsaw and attends a lecture about ethics. Afterwards, she approaches Zofia, the lecturer, and says that she is the little Jewish girl whom Zofia refused to shelter during World War II. But Zofia has a very good reason for her apparent cowardice…

9.o: “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife.” Roman, after discovering his impotence, urges his wife Hanka to take a lover. She reluctantly complies, and Roman, despite his earlier words, becomes obsessively jealous. Spying on her, he learns of her affair, and vows to kill himself—not knowing that Hanka was in fact breaking off the relationship…

10.o: “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s goods.” Especially not when it leads to the conclusion of this black comedy about two brothers who inherit their father’s valuable stamp collection and end up paying rather more than they bargained for…

1.o: A civil-rights issue hinges on the casting choice for a version of "Annie"; a child-custody battle turns ugly; an adultery case involves Crane.

2.t: Still Crazy After All These Years
2.o: An ex-lover haunts Shore, who secures the woman's release from a psychiatric hospital where she was confined after trying to kill him. Elsewhere, Crane fights an opposing counsel's sanction charges.

3.o: A client of Crane, Poole & Schmidt want to build a shopping mall on an area where salmon are spawning and Denny's son is the environmental lawyer defending the area. Alan and Lori take a sexual harassment case and learn that Christine, whom he recently helped get released from a mental institution and who he now fears is stalking him, is opposing counsel. Sally has her first trial case where she defends a man who is accused of stealing a wallet.

4.o: A cop killing centers on a haughty defendant, reluctantly represented by Lori and zealously by a firm veteran, who has been a patient in a mental facility. Meanwhile, Shore plays hardball with a witness in a shoplifting case involving a kleptomaniac CEO.

5.o: Seniors take on a drug firm in a class-action case handled by the grandstanding Crane. Also: revenge motives are raised in a murder trial; and medical ethics are at issue in a civil suit.

6.o: Shore's dream lover from college, now wed to a slick mayoral candidate, hires Shore to block his opponent's provocative TV-ad campaign. Meanwhile, a power struggle embroils Crane.

7.o: A showcase for the wily, agitating Alan Shore, who badgers a dotty judge; romances Tara, whom he surreptitiously helps in a thorny criminal case; and backs Crane, who's been arrested for solicitation.

8.o: Alan help a department store Santa sue to get his job back after he is terminated for being a transvestite. Brad bets Alan that he won't win. A therapist seeks Lori's help when one of his patients fantasizes about killing his ex-wife.

9.o: Alan and Denny defend a drug company that is being sued by a woman who states they provided false reasoning when they took her off of an experimental pill that was a possible cure for her sickness. Alan and Denny discover a shocking secret that could make or break their case and because of that, they become at odds with each other on how to proceed. Lori discovers that Tara's new information for their case would win it for them, but the way she retrieved it could cost them their case and their careers. Lori learns a secret about Brad.

10.o: Lori and Brad defend a woman who is accused of murdering her husband and his mistress while they were in bed together. Alan's life is endangered when he helps a woman whose ex-husband plans to kidnap their children.

11.o: A Sudanese native wants to sue the U.S. government for the lack of action taken against the mayhem happening in his country and Paul looks to Lori to take the case. Founding partner Shirley Schmidt arrives with a mission to bring order to the firm. While making herself known, she has to deal with Denny who does not wanting her there, help with Lori's extremely high profile case, and learns that she has to keep her eye on Alan. Alan ends up defending a man who killed his mother in a fit of rage but by accident.

12.o: Lori, along with Denny and Shirley, defends a school superintendent who fired two science teachers because they refused to teach creationism and is now being sued by them. Alan learns his assistant has expressed concern about their work relationship. While dealing with that issue, Alan discovers that his client Bernard Ferrion, who killed his mother, needs legal help again. One of the members of the firm is fired and learns that a close associate is not too keen on lending a supportive hand.

13.o: Brad becomes attracted to his client who being sued for having a relationship with her boss merely for financial purposes. To make matters more difficult, Brad convinces himself that she is lying about her being a lesbian. Alan is asked to second chair on Denny's trial case where a doctor is being sued for prescribing a drug that has not been FDA approved. While working on that, Denny is on a personal mission to prove that he is a competent attorney. Meanwhile, the staff tries to deal with Alan's out-spoken new assistant, Catherine Piper.

14.o: While out with Tara, Alan ends up causing a bar room brawl and as a result, becomes arrested for conspiracy to commit assault and battery. Shirley and Denny represent a man whose steakhouse is being put out of business because the public wants to ban red meat for fear of Mad Cow disease.

15.o: Shirley asks Alan Shore to use his odious lawyering to help her defend a police officer accused of torture. Donny Crane returns and is the opposing counsel in Denny's case, with Chelina Hall as second chair, where a woman wants to sue her former boyfriend for saying no to her at the alter. For Denny, this is an easy case, for Donny this is to settle a score with Denny for letting him believe for 25 years that he was his father. Meanwhile, Bernard Ferrion is befriended by Catherine and Alan finds variance with that.

16.o: Milton Bombay is asking the courts to allow him to be frozen until another century so he can continue his legacy of being a great lawyer and needs Denny and Shirley to defend him. Alan and Chelina defends a high school student who accuses his teacher of censorship when he blocks out a news station on the school's televisions.

17.o: Chelina asks Alan to assist her in Texas because her former client is getting executed but may be innocent of the crime. An old friend of Denny and Shirley asks them for legal representation when she charged with having sexual encounters for a fee. Lori files a complaint about Denny with Shirley and Paul and they seriously consider doing something about it; especially when they suspect he performed an unethical act on his recent case.

1.o: Alan Shore and Brad Chase represent Kelly Nolan who is on trial for poisoning her husband. Meanwhile, Tara Wilson second-chairs for Shirley Schmidt and is shocked to find that the opposing counsel is her former lover, Malcolm Holmes. Garrett Wells and Sara Holt assist Denise Bauer on a case where a Jewish man felt violated when his Christian co-workers held Bible readings in the workplace. To make things worse, Denise is served with divorce papers.

2.o: The Kelly Nolan trial continues, but Alan, Denny and Brad run fear the worst when Kelly's cold demeanor begins to turn off the jury. Meanwhile, Garrett and Sara are enlisted to help Denise in her divorce settlement and Malcolm convinces Tara to represent Johnny Damon, Edwin Starr's nephew, whose performance of War strikes a nerve at a nightclub.

3.o: Denny takes Alan to Nimmo Bay, British Columbia, Canada, to help him get over his breakup with Tara. Catherine confesses to Bernard's murder. Sara and Garrett take extreme measures to help Denise challenge her husband's alimony demands in their divorce proceedings.

4.o: Denny's strong conservative values are put to the test when the firm represents a Democratic congressman who refused to keep a promise to his supporters. Alan tries to forget about Tara as he prepares to defend Catherine who is on trial for murder. Meanwhile, Sara is given a bizarre ultimatum.

5.o: Denise finds herself in a difficult position when an auto-injury case she neglected for three years comes up for trial and she is unprepared. While Garrett researches, he meets Cassie, a young paralegal whose strange sexual tendencies hide a painful past. Meanwhile Denny learns he must apologize to Lori or face a sexual harrassment suit, and Alan takes Sara out for dinner and a "show."

6.o: The firm takes on two milestone cases. First, Shirley and Denise represent Christian and Wiccan parents who are outraged by a public school's Halloween celebrations, but the case takes a turn for the worse when the clients begin arguing amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Denny and Alan's friendship is tested when Alan helps Cassie sue the US military for the loss of her brother.

7.o: Denny is called to defend a man who raped and killed a 13-year-old girl, but decides he'd rather go to jail than spend his days defending murderers. Meanwhile, Alan must face his fear of clowns and Shirley dumps a bizarre bestiality case on Denise.

Shirley takes on a difficult case involving an Alzheimer's patient which touches her personally. Meanwhile, a victim of Dong-jin's work comes to get his vengeance, which makes him realize numbers aren't the answers to everything. Afterward, he returns to his hometown to find clues that will break Mi-jung's witch's curse.

5.o: Dong-jin returns to Taebaek in search of a clue that could break the witch’s curse on Mi-jung. With the support of his friends, he meticulously compiles information about the string of accidents and uncovers a disturbing pattern. As he digs deeper, he realises that he meets every condition of his hypothesis, leaving him filled with suspicion and uncertainty.

6.o: To uncover the missing years in his investigation, Dong-jin reaches out to Eun-sil, the one person who has been close to Mi-jung since their university days. With her help, he uncovers more accidents and deaths tied to her, strengthening his theory. As the puzzle pieces fall into place, Dong-jin realises the only way truly to validate his findings is to put himself to the ultimate test.

7.o: Dong-jin takes on a delivery job at the supermarket where Mi-jung regularly shops. Every Tuesday, as he delivers her orders, he begins to test the theory he's been developing about her. Gradually, he pushes the boundaries of his own rules, discovering just how dangerous it can be to remain within a ten-meter radius of her. Yet, despite the growing risks, his deepening desire to be closer to her and to linger in her presence threatens to draw him into ever greater peril.

8.o: Aware of the dire consequences of getting too close for too long, Dong-jin plunges into the river in a desperate attempt to save himself. However, Mi-jung recognises him, intensifying the danger he's already in. As he recovers in the hospital, Dong-jin turns to Producer Heo, seeking her help to identify a key variable in his hypothesis that might hold the solution he is desperately searching for.

1.o: In the near future, civilization has collapsed, and the world has become a wasteland. Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

2.o: The city is abuzz with the news that a grand theft has been carried out by Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213. On the run from the police, the three culprits return to the junk shop, only to fail to receive their reward.

3.t: I Learned Not to Trust People
3.o: With one assassin after another hot on their trail, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 find themselves fleeing from intense pursuit. They cannot get hold of Noah, and their beloved car, Bullet, is running dangerously low on gas. The trio must quickly devise a plan to escape the mess they are in.

4.o: Reunited safely with Noah, the trio hands over the requested item, only to find that it is not what Noah wanted at all. The real treasure is a completely different item.

5.o: Gear is left crushed by a sense of helplessness after Noah is kidnapped. Gear stumbles across a Gotcha spinoff titled, "The Escape Story of the Great Villain Road." Watching the unstoppable determination of the hero stirs something within Gear, reigniting his resolve.

6.t: You Have the Right to Know
6.o: After Gear, Qu-0213, and Noah are arrested by the capital's police and separated from White Bear, they are taken underground, facing imminent execution. However, at the last moment, their restraints are mysteriously removed.

7.o: Shaken with sorrow and anger after learning the truth, Gear and his friends decide to collaborate with the Resistance, determined to expose the government's secret to the world. As the day of the operation approaches, they work tirelessly to prepare for the challenges that loom on the horizon.

8.t: The World Is Much Bigger, Tougher, and Uglier
8.o: Gear and his team race to escape with the top-secret government data they have stolen, but Barrel blocks their path, announcing that their plan has already failed. Gear, driven by an unshakeable determination to change the world, refuses to give up.

9.t: That Guy Is Like Spinach Stuck in Your Teeth
9.o: Captured by the National Security Agency, Gear, White Bear and Qu-0213 are imprisoned in an extremely cold and desolate facility. Stripped of their freedom, each of the three is forced to confront their personal struggles and the harsh realities of their situation.

10.t: I Have Discovered a Way Only I Can Change the World
10.o: Following their failed escape attempt, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 are imprisoned on a secluded island surrounded only by the sea. As they adapt to life behind bars, they unexpectedly cross paths with the assassin Cook siblings.

11.o: Gear and his comrades, joined by the assassins and the Resistance, race toward the capital at full speed. However, their path is blocked by the government’s autonomous security system. To make matters worse, the capital’s police forces launch an assault from both the ground and the skies.

12.o: After a fierce struggle, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 finally reach the deepest part of the capital’s underground. To destroy the core of the system, they head through a door, eventually arriving in a pitch-black space. A spotlight flickers on, revealing a mysterious figure.

1.o: After making a miraculous recovery, Peacemaker returns home–only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

2.o: After Peacemaker’s hazardous escape, tension and mistrust build within the team. Later, as Peacemaker grapples with his new assignment, he receives a surprise visitor.

3.o: On their first official mission to assassinate suspected “butterflies,” Economos and Murn bond, and Peacemaker and Harcourt reach an understanding. But the whole job goes sideways with the arrival of Judomaster.

4.o: Following a somewhat successful mission, Murn recruits Vigilante. Meanwhile, after learning that the team helped land his father in prison, Peacemaker confronts his complicated past.

5.o: The team scouts the apparent hub for the aliens’ food supply, only to come face-to-face with a full-fledged invasion. Meanwhile, Auggie’s attempt to sell out his son to the police is complicated by Murn’s mysterious contact.

6.o: Murn reveals his deepest secret. Auggie is set free. The botched arrest of Peacemaker sends alien Goff into an unexpected new host.

7.o: Harcourt, Murn, and Adebayo find themselves surrounded by an alien force, while Peacemaker squares off against his father with help from Vigilante and Economos.

8.o: With Peacemaker and Adebayo at odds, can the team kill the cow once and for all – or will their fracture give the aliens the opening they need to complete its teleportation?

1.o: While Peacemaker attempts to join the Justice Gang, Harcourt struggles to find work, and Economos takes on a challenging new assignment.

2.t: A Man Is Only As Good As His Bird
2.o: As Economos clashes with his new handler, Peacemaker must deal with the consequences of his actions in the alternate dimension.

3.o: Economos pays for the team's bungled mission, while Peacemaker explores the depths of his relationship with Harcourt in the other dimension.

4.o: As A.R.G.U.S. ramps up efforts to find the QUC, Harcourt receives a tempting offer from Flag – which comes at a steep cost to Peacemaker.

5.o: After a catastrophic showdown with Flag, Peacemaker makes a shocking decision, while his friends scramble to keep the 11th Street Kids together.

6.o: As the 11th Street Kids fight to bring their missing member home, Flag doubles down on his efforts to hold Peacemaker accountable.

7.t: Like a Keith in the Night
7.o: As Flag and A.R.G.U.S. close in, the 11th Street Kids attempt to keep the ever-increasing dangers of the alternate world around them at bay.

8.o: As Flag puts everyone around him in increasing danger, the 11th Street Kids must convince Peacemaker that he's one of them.

1.o: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps welcome nine pairs of gifted professional pastry chefs and cake artists to Warner Bros. Leavesden Studios, home to the iconic sets of the Harry Potter films. For their first challenge, the bakers must create an edible showpiece that is at least 2 feet tall, includes at least one magical effect, and tells the story of their shared love of Harry Potter. Plus, each team member must make a tasting element that showcases their individual specialty. Expert culinary judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers will earn a ticket to board the Hogwarts Express t

2.o: The remaining teams enter the breathtaking world of Gringotts Wizarding Bank to face off in three head-to-head battles. Hosts James and Oliver Phelps ask the bakers to create 3-foot showpieces inspired by the resplendent main hall, the network of tunnels and carts, and the underground vaults. The creations must also include at least one enchanting effect and two tasting elements, plus a surprise hidden treasure! Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef are joined by Harry Potter alumnus Warwick Davis to decide the winner, and one team will be sent home.

3.o: In a salute to the famed Diagon Alley, hosts James and Oliver Phelps ask each team to create fifty identical handheld desserts, inspired by one of the many different shops, and feed them to a crowd of eager Harry Potter fans on the actual set. The bakers must present their desserts in a way that highlights an interactive, magical effect. The Potter fans will vote for a winner, while judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team must leave the competition.

4.o: Inspired by the legendary Forbidden Forest outside Hogwarts, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create a 3-foot-tall grand showpiece that celebrates the dark arts. Plus, one of the two tasting elements must have at least 10 layers and feature an enchanting effect that appears to defy gravity! Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef are joined by Harry Potter alumna Evanna Lynch.

5.o: It's the semi-finals, and the remaining teams must draw inspiration from the office of headmaster Albus Dumbledore's office, which houses many iconic items from Harry Potter lore. And since the office is also home to Fawkes the Phoenix, hosts James and Oliver Phelps request that part of each team's 4-foot-tall showpiece should appear to be transforming from one thing to another. Plus, the tasting elements must highlight two of the four pillars of flavor: sweet, sour, spicy and salty. Harry Potter alumna Bonnie Wright joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to decide which teams will go on to

6.o: It's the final showdown in the illustrious Great Hall, and hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to create a showpiece that reaches at least 6 feet tall and commemorates at least one event that takes place in the Great Hall. The bakers must also include two enchanting culinary effects and incorporate at least two tasting elements.

1.o: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps welcome eight pairs of talented pastry wizards to the Great Hall, and with the help of the Sorting Hat, assign the teams into the four Hogwarts Houses. The bakers are challenged to create a massive showpiece that is inspired by their assigned house, and the teammates must collaborate to make one tasting element. Expert culinary judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which bakers will move on to the next challenge.

2.o: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps meet the remaining six teams in front of the Knight Bus and challenge them to create showpieces inspired by magical transportation from the Harry Potter world that give the illusion of movement. Plus, the bakers are assigned classic English desserts that must be incorporated into their tasting elements. Special guest Devon Murray, who played Seamus Finnigan in the Harry Potter films, surprises the competitors and joins Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef in deciding which team will be sent home.

3.o: Baking meets the bubbling world of transfiguration as the five remaining teams find themselves in the Potions classroom. Inspired by Polyjuice Potion, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the bakers to recreate two items from the Harry Potter world, such as a Nimbus 2001 broom or Beater's Bats, as hyperrealistic edible showpieces. The teams start to crack under the pressure as one pair uses the Devil's Snare penalty to tie up the competition. Judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef decide which team made the most convincing and delicious edible artifact.

4.o: Hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the baking teams to create supersized iconic Harry Potter artifacts that reveal something from within. For the tasting element, the teams are assigned a flavor of Bertie Bott's Every Flavor Beans, featuring baked beans, curry, marshmallow, toast and even grass. Special guest Afshan Azad, who played Padma Patil in the Harry Potter films, joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef.

5.o: The semifinals kick off inside the legendary Gringotts Wizarding Bank, where hosts James and Oliver Phelps ask the remaining four baking teams to create showpieces that magically bring an iconic Harry Potter creature to life. The fantastical creations must also include a bold smoky or spicy tasting element inspired by the Hungarian Horntail. Special guest Warwick Davis, who played Professor Flitwick in the Harry Potter films, joins judges Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to decide which teams move on to the grand finale.

6.o: For the final showdown in the illustrious Great Hall, hosts James and Oliver Phelps challenge the three baking teams to create showpieces celebrating the Goblet of Fire. The epic creations are presented to a crowd of Harry Potter superfans. Guest judges Warwick Davis, Afshan Azad and Devon Murray return to join Carla Hall and Jozef Youssef to award the trophy and crown the Wizards of Baking champions.

1.o: في رحلته إلى البطولة القادمة في أشفورد، يلتقي دانك بصبي ذكي يدعى إيغ، والذي يعرض أن يكون مرافقه.

2.o: يتوسل دانك إلى العديد من اللوردات ليتمكن من المشاركة في البطولة، لكن إيغ ينصحه بالحفاظ على كبريائه. وعندما يصل آل تارغاريان إلى أشفورد، ينتهز دانك الفرصة للقاء الأمير بايلور.

3.o: يستعد سير دنكان للبطولة، ويتم الكشف عن المزيد من المعلومات حول إيغ.

4.o: يُثير دانك غضب آل تارغاريان ويطالب بمحاكمة بالقتال. وعندما يدعو إيريون إلى محاكمة سبعة محاربين، يتعين على دانك إيجاد ستة محاربين للانضمام إليه في المعركة.

5.t: In the Name of the Mother
5.o: تُختبر عزيمة دانك في المحاكمة الوحشية المكونة من سبعة أفراد. قبل سنوات، يجد دانك نفسه منجذبًا إلى وعد بمستقبل جديد.

6.o: بينما ينعى أشفورد خسارة كبيرة، يفكر دانك في خطوته التالية... وما إذا كان سيبقي إيغ كمساعده.

1.o: Mary Bennet longs to shine as brightly as her sisters but often feels overlooked. She hopes to finally win her family’s approval at the upcoming Meryton assembly.

2.o: After a disappointing night at the ball, Mary sets aside hopes of finding a match. But when a visitor arrives at Longbourn with a surprising proposal, she must rethink her plan.

3.o: After a family tragedy, Mary and her mother are left facing an uncertain future – until Mary receives an unexpected offer from her aunt and uncle.

4.o: As Mary is finding her footing in London, she overhears something which knocks her confidence. Mary’s connection with Mr Hayward is complicated by his engagement to Mary’s friend Ann.

5.o: Mary begins to flourish in London society, but a run-in with an old rival and troubling news from home threaten her growing confidence and force her to face up to the past.

6.o: Mary rushes to Pemberley, where she is swept back into her family’s orbit. It feels as if Mary is right back where she started – until a visit from Mr Ryder shakes things up.

7.o: Mary weighs up an offer from Mr Ryder. Under pressure from her mother, Mary must decide what she truly wants and if she has the courage to disappoint her family one more time.

8.o: Mary finds peace and a growing connection with Mr Hayward in the Lake District – until the arrival of a group of unexpected guests threatens their new understanding.

9.o: During a group hike up Scafell Pike, Mary prepares to speak her heart, but a fateful miscommunication and a sudden storm threaten to throw everything off course.

10.o: Mary receives a surprising offer and faces renewed pressure from her mother to find a match. With Mr Hayward absent from London, she must decide what happiness looks like for her.

1.o: Ruthless Emperor Xiao Xun wipes out the Chu clan and strangles his empress. Mysteriously reborn on the eve of their wedding, Chu Zhao vows revenge.

2.o: Xiao Xun launches his rebellion early, but Chu Zhao fights her way into the palace to thwart his ascension and reshape the empire's fate.

3.o: Now regent, Chu Zhao appoints her trusted ally to lead the Imperial Guard. But as tensions mount, Xiao Xun lays a trap — and she's ready for it.

4.o: Xiao Xun accuses Chu Zhao of poisoning the young emperor, but she turns his plot against him — until an assassin strikes at court.

5.o: Chu Zhao sets a trap to frame Xiao Xun as a defector, but Deng Yi aids his escape — putting Xie Yanlai in deadly peril along the way.

6.o: Xie Yanfang flexes his power by engineering an invasion on the frontier. With her father gravely ill, Chu Zhao defies the court to ride to his aid.

7.o: Chu Zhao disguises herself among dispatch riders to evade Xiao Xun's ambush. Meanwhile, Yanlai risks everything to follow her to the frontier.

8.o: Chu Zhao and Yanlai take shelter at Cangmu Stronghold, where she reveals her rebirth and past life to him. He vows to defy fate by her side.

9.o: Chu Zhao sets up an ambush for Tie Ying at the Cangmu stronghold. Later, Xiao Xun colludes with the Northern Desert to launch an attack.

10.o: With Wangcheng under siege, Chu Zhao devises a daring chain of stratagems to break free. Far away, her ailing father receives word of her battle.

11.o: Chu Zhao reaches her gravely ill father, but a shocking discovery follows. Elsewhere, Deng Yi falls into Yanfang's devious trap.

12.o: Chu Zhao learns a shattering truth about her birth mother from Chu Ling and that Yanlai is partially responsible for her father's chronic illness.

13.o: Chu Zhao buries her grief to fight alongside Yanlai against the Northern Desert — but victory demands a staggering price from those she loves most.

14.o: Xiao Xun intercepts Chu Zhao's victory dispatches and marches on the capital. As rivals scheme for power, he burns the imperial edict and openly rebels.

15.o: Chu Zhao and Yanlai use the Longwei Army to force the Lord of Xiaonan to withdraw. Back in the capital, Deng Yi and Xie Yanfang's rivalry escalates.

16.o: Chu Tang devises a plan to capture Xiao Xun, giving Chu Zhao leverage to force a surrender. Deng Yi issues an amnesty to end the conflict.

17.o: After exchanging a lifelong vow, Chu Zhao and Yanlai part ways. She returns to the capital to court allies and secure power — but Yanfang is watching.

18.o: When Deng Yi blocks Chu Zhao's bid to give Yanlai command of the frontier troops, Yanlai stakes his life on a vow to slay the Northern Desert King.

19.o: Yanlai refuses to enshrine his mother in the Xie ancestral hall and opens up to Chu Zhao. At court, Chu Zhao rattles Xiao Xun with a fire oil inquiry.

20.o: Chu Zhao cracks down on corruption in Jingzhou as Yanfang feigns illness to mask a deadly move. An ill omen for Yanlai leaves Chu Zhao on edge.

21.o: Yanfang lets Northern Desert forces ambush Zhong Changrong, but Yanlai rides to the rescue — then launches a daring assault on the desert royal court.

22.o: Deng Yi fakes his death and flees with Xiao Xun, who poisons his father and raises an army. As the war escalates, Chu Zhao rides out to fight — alone.

23.o: Chu Zhao storms Xiaonan and uncovers the true mastermind behind the upheaval — but a power grab leaves her imprisoned. Then the impossible happens.

24.o: Chu Zhao feigns submission and secretly mentors the young emperor for one last gambit. Everything she's fought for comes down to this.

1.o: تنقلب حياة الصديقتين المقربتين ديبي كلايبورن وجوديث برتن رأساً على عقب عندما تكتشف ديبي أن جوديث ليست محاسبة جنائية، بل قاتلة محترفة دولية! وعندما تظهر شخصية غامضة من ماضي جوديث وتفشل عملية اغتيال فشلاً ذريعاً، تُضطران إلى الهرب معاً.

2.o: في أعقاب الحفل، تسعى جوديث جاهدةً لكشف هوية من دبّر لها المكيدة. وتبحث ديبي عن إجابات بشأن زوجها وتكتشف حقيقةً مروعة. ويمنح المدير جوديث فرصةً أخيرةً لإتمام مهمتها، ويكتشف سام مكان اختباء بيلي دونوفان.

3.o: تأخذ رحلة ديبي وجوديث بالسيارة إلى أوروبا منعطفاً غير متوقع عندما تُضطران إلى السفر بقطار فاخر، ليكتشفا أنهما مُلاحقتان. ويتضح أن المرأة التي قضى معها سام ليلة عابرة ليست كما تبدو. وتوافق كويني على مساعدة سام في العثور على جثة. ويُعطى الألبان خيطاً يقودهم إلى الحقيقة. وتتوصل ديبي إلى اكتشاف مُستحيل.

4.o: تصل جوديث وديبي إلى إسبانيا وهما في حالة صدمة بعد اكتشافهما أمر ديفيد. ويضع المدير جوديث أمام خيار صعب. ويحقق محقق الإنتربول جاك بوشيه في جثة على متن القطار. وتتعاون ديبي وجوديث للعثور على بيلي دونوفان، وتستعيد ديبي حيويتها. ويتخذ سام وكويني قراراً خطيراً. ويقترب الألبان.

5.o: ينطلق ثلاثة أشخاص غير متوقعين إلى مونت كارلو لتعقب أموال الرشوة المفقودة لديفيد. وتُضطر جوديث إلى استخدام غطاء قديم، وتضع ديبي خطة محفوفة بالمخاطر، ولا تعرف أي منهما ما إن كان بإمكانهما الوثوق ببيلي دونوفان. ويُخيّب سام آمال كويني. وتزور السيدة ويليامز زميلة سابقة.

6.o: مع تعرّض جوديث لخطر يهدد حياتها، يتعين على ديبي وبيلي اتخاذ قرار بشأن الخطوة التالية. ويقدّم سام لجوديث معلومات مرعبة، وتُكشف أسرار من ماضيها. وتواجه كويني المدير، ويعرض جاك على ديبي صفقة، ويتولى سام وكويني زمام الأمور بأنفسهما وينطلقان في مهمة خطيرة.

7.o: تتلاقى جميع الطرق في جنيف مع اقتراب الجميع من استعادة الأموال المسروقة. وتكتشف جوديث وجود ضيوف غير متوقعين، ويتحرك الإنتربول والألبان، وتنشأ قصة حب. وعندما تسوء الأمور، تجد جوديث وديبي نفسيهما في خطر محدق.

8.o: في لندن، تبدو صداقة جوديث وديبي وكأنها لا سبيل لإصلاحها. وتكتشف كويني حقيقة صادمة، ويواجه سام تبعات أفعاله، ويعيد المدير جوديث مجدداً. ومع اكتمال خطة آنا، تنطلق ديبي وجوديث نحو خاتمة موسم مذهلة.
